summary: PowerBank Corporation filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that its 3.26 MW Camillus ground-mount community solar project in New York reached permission to operate; the project was previously sold to and constructed for Solar Advocate Development LLC in a transaction valued at US$7.3 million. No price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory timeline was disclosed. Camillus is sited on a closed landfill and serves community solar subscribers, with Solar Simplified handling enrollment for PowerBank subsidiary Abundant Solar Power; no capital structure or closing mechanics were detailed. Watch for revenue contribution and further asset-sale disclosures.
